Section B 
 
 
1. Understanding the dataset  
There are many input variables in this dataset. Use only X1 to X4 as input 
variables, and y as the output variable. 
Using the scatter plots between each of the input features (X1-X4) and the 
output (Y), which input variable, do you think, is better in predicting the output 
/ target variable ?

The input variable “ X2 house age” is better in predicting the output / target 
variable

2. Write code to find out how many samples are there in total in this dataset?  
 
 
 
 
3. What is the train test split ratio that you have chosen ?
